services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Luther Heights Bible Camp staff partners with churches across Idaho and Wyoming to make Luther Heights On-Location Day Camp a week your kids won’t want to miss! From Camp Worship, silly songs, tie-dying t-shirts, Bible Studies, games, and a fun water day, this is sure to be the highlight of your kiddos’ summer! Click the REGISTER button at the top right corner to join us for our on-location day camp
